summary.intent: Remove low-value tests and over-exposed API surface in the monokl `query` module (trail #309), delegating the work to a subagent and reporting the resulting PR to the user.
summary.outcome: PR #84 was opened and marked ready, deleting 702 lines and narrowing `monokl::query` to `pub(crate)`. The subagent reported `just ci` and rg-compare passing; the assistant confirmed the changed files were as expected but CI was still 2 passed, 0 failed, 6 pending. The ranking-fields deletion and `finalScore` order-identity check are still running.

repo: `monokl::query` is only used by the pipeline, so the whole module can be `pub(crate)`, not just lexer/parser/plan.
Narrowing public API requires a minor changeset in this repo.
Making the module private left `QueryPlan::is_empty` dead, so it was removed along with its tests, leaving one exclusion-only test.
Narrowing visibility forced edits to a doc link in `pipeline/mod.rs` and to `docs/architecture/query-and-ranking.md`.
`scripts/rg-compare.py` is run after `cargo build --release` as a regression harness. Baseline scores are 58/59, 17/18, 15/16, 22/24, 23/24 and 12/12.

Tests deleted were non-semantic probes: source-scanning tests, const probes asserting derives are absent, exhaustiveness re-tests, `compile_fail` doctests, derive/shape tests, discriminant-pinning and lexer-path reachability tests. Lexing, parsing, plan behavior tests and proptests were kept.

code.finding: A doc link here had to be updated after `monokl::query` became `pub(crate)`. This is the only source file modified in the session; the specific line is not given in the transcript.

workflow: Subagent reports are model output, so the assistant independently checked CI status and the PR's changed-file list instead of relaying the claims.
The assistant declined to call the PR green while 6 CI checks were still pending.

friction: CI on PR #84 was still running (6 checks pending), so the result could not be confirmed.
The subagent's 'all checks run' claim could only be partly verified by the assistant.
open_items: Confirm CI on PR #84 passes once the pending checks finish.
Report the outcome of the ranking-fields deletion, which is still running.
Report the `finalScore` order-identity check, which is also still running.
